user.title: Connect to a Geist device
user.description: Enter the device URL, an optional name for this entry and, if required, its credentials. The integration detects whether the device uses the XML or JSON API.

reconfigure.title: Update Geist device connection
reconfigure.description: Update the device URL, entry name and optional credentials. Clear the username and password to connect without authentication.

error.auth: The username or password is wrong, or the account lacks the required permissions.
error.connection: Unable to connect to the server.
error.already_configured: This device URL is already configured.
